        STATE LEVEL ELIGIBILITY TEST COMMISSION, ASSAM
                            (N E Region)
                     North Jalukbari, Guwahati – 781014

                           Notification No. SET/RP/2023/84/8840

                                Dated :22-07-2023

              It is for general information that the result of the SET Exam of SLET Commission,
Assam (N. E. Region) held on 19th Mach, 2023 has been declared and uploaded the website
www.sletne.orgon 22nd July, 2023.
        The result has been finalised following the circular issued from the UGC vide letter
No – F-4-2/90 (NET) 13th June, 2017. The matter has already been incorporated in the
Information Brochure uploaded in the website at the time of issue of notification for filling-
up of examination from for online process.
        The Certificates will be issued to the successful candidates after 45 days. The
candidates will have to deposit Rs. 250/- at www.sletneonline.co.in or through Bank Challan.
The original mark-sheet of P.G., Caste Certificate/ Special category Certificates / up-to-date
Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (up-to-date means certificate in favour of Candidate as on last
date of filling up Forms not as on issue of Certificate or received of Certificate by the
Candidates). An Admit Card of SET will have to be submitted for verification before issue of
Certificates. If discrepancy in documents and testimonies are detected then such candidates
will be treated as unsuccessful and no certificate will issued in favour of them.




                                                             -Sd-
                                           Member Secretary
                                        SLET Commission, Assam
                                                       (N. E. Region)
                                                     Gauhati University
                                                  Guwahati – 781 014

               STATE LEVEL ELIGIBILITY TEST COMIISSION, ASSAM
                                              (N. E. Region)
                              North Jalukbari, Guwahati – 781 014



                                       Notification No. SLET/RP/23/84/8840

                                       Dated : 22-07-2023

This is notified that the following Roll Nos. appeared in SET, 2023 (held on 19-03-2023) are declared pass in the
Test and are eligible for Assistant Professor in Colleges and Universities of N.E. States including Sikkim.

                 The criteria adopted during the finalization of the result are as follows:

It has been decided by the UGC that 6% of the appearing candidates should be qualified for Eligibility for Assistant
Professors.

           i)      In order to be considered for eligibility for Assistant Professor, the candidates must have appeared
                 in two papers and secured at least 40% aggregate marks in two papers taken together for General
               (Unreserved) & General EWS Category candidates and at least 35% aggregate marks in  two
               papers taken together for all candidates belonging to reserved categories, viz  -  SC/ST/OBC
               (belonging to Non Creamy Layer) and PWD.

           ii)     The calculation is based on the ratio of number of candidates who secure minimum aggregate
               percentage of marks as prescribed in (i) above in each subject, category-wise to the total number of
               candidates of that category over all subjects fulfilling (ii) above multiplied by the total number of
                  slots to be awarded to that category. The nearest whole number obtained as per this formula
               provides the number of slots available in any particular subject category-wise.

           iii)    By this method, if the number of slots obtained is less than one, it is taken as one, i.e. a minimum
                of one slot is awarded, wherever a fraction less than one is obtained as per the calculation.
             However, for fractions greater than one, the figure is rounded off to the nearest whole number.

         iv)    The aggregate percentage of all the two papers corresponding to the number of slots derived as per
                the previous paragraphis taken as the cut-off qualifying percentage marks for a particular subject
                category-wise.

                                          (In the Order of Roll Nos Subject-wise)

       The candidates, having any claim with regard to declaration of result of SET, after evaluation of OMR as
per Answer-key uploaded in the web-site may send a written request to the Member Secretary, SLET Commission,
Assam (N. E. Region) supporting his/her stand along with a Demand Draft for Rs. 5,000/- in favour of the Member
Secretary payable at SBI, GU Branch at Jalukbari within 15 days from the date of declaration of result.  If the
evaluation is/are found to be incorrect, that will be rectified in the light of re-evaluation. The amount of Rs. 5,000/-
will be refunded in such cases, other-wise it will be forfeited. The cut-off marks Subject-wise & Category-wise are
also uploaded.




                                                        Member Secretary
                                                                      SLET Commission, Assam
                                                                                  (N. E. Region)
                                                                       Gauhati University
                                                                   Guwahati – 781 014
